blocks.label: Overview
bullets: Protein with More Than 100% of Key B-Vitamins for Energy
paragraphs: Designer Wellness's diverse family of protein powders have been crafted in the health-oriented seaside community of Carlsbad, CA for over 25 years. Today, its unparalleled heritage of innovation is stronger than ever.

Loaded with B-Vitamins, natural plant enzymes and microbial probiotics for digestibility. Plus, calcium, vitamin D, phosphorus, magnesium and electrolytes are included to assist post-workout recovery. Zinc has been shown to aid in boosting the immune system and energy metabolism.

Made from natural, GMO-free whey from midwest cows cared for with a diet free of artificial growth hormones and antibiotics. There are no artificial colors, flavors, sweeteners or preservatives in our protein powder. It contains no gluten and is 93% lactose-free.
*Natural whey protein with added nutritional benefits.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Combine one scoop with 6 to 8 oz of cold water or milk (skim or your favorite non-dairy) and mix thoroughly. Enjoy as a delicious, blended smoothie to start your day, as an easy shake on-the-go or after your workout.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Designer whey protein blend: (gmo-free and rBGH-Free whey protein concentrate, gmo-free and rBGH-Free whey protein isolate), digestive health blend: [gmo-free prebiotic vegetable fiber, probiotics: (lactobacillus acidophilus, b. longum, l. plantarum), vegetarian protease enzymes], alkalized cocoa, natural flavors, electrolyte blend: (calcium phosphate, magnesium oxide), sunflower lecithin, stevia leaf extract, dried cream extract, monk fruit, b-vitamin blend: (calcium pantothenate, pyridoxine hydrochloride, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin), zinc gluconate, xanthan gum, sodium alginate, mixed tocopherols, vitamin d3 (cholecalciferol).
Made in U.S.A. with domestic & global ingredients.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Use this product as food supplement only. Do not use for weight reduction. Consult your physician before use if you are pregnant, nursing, anticipating surgery or if you are under medical supervision. Do not use for infant feeding. Packaged by weight not volume.
Store in a cool, dry place. Settling will occur. A scoop is provided for convenience. Keep out of the reach of children.
